native_metrics: PPV, NPV, alert workload and capacity
latency, throughput, memory and package size
rules: Each validity axis remains in its native metric and population.
Delta-F1, Delta-PR-AUC, milliseconds, PPV, workload and ROC-AUC are not commensurable.
No ranking may combine heterogeneous stages through rescaling or qualitative cutoffs.
Cross-stage synthesis may compare conclusions and scope, not manufacture a shared numerical degradation score.
Any apparent conflict must first be checked for population, split, learner, threshold, seed, target and metric differences.
